en.headline: Record 16 young Hong Kong officers recommended for UN Junior Professional posts
en.dek: The third batch, drawn from 12 government departments and bureaux, will begin two-year assignments this month at UN headquarters and offices in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi.
body: Sixteen young public officers from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region have been recommended by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to join the United Nations Junior Professional Officer programme, the largest cohort since Hong Kong began participating in the scheme.

A launch ceremony was held today at the Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the HKSAR. The officers come from the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, the Census and Statistics Department, the Civil Engineering and Development Department, Customs and Excise, the Department of Justice, the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department, the Hong Kong Observatory, the Police Force, the Intellectual Property Department, the Lands Department and the Independent Commission Against Corruption.

They will serve as Chinese personnel at UN Headquarters and at offices in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi for two-year tenures and begin departing this month. Chief Executive John Lee said previous cohorts had excelled and earned high praise from the United Nations, with nearly half seeing their contracts extended. He encouraged the new group to act as a super connector and super value-adder linking Hong Kong and the nation with the world.
Hong Kong previously sent five officers in 2019 and 12 in 2023 under the same programme.

zh.headline: 歷來最多16名青年公務員獲推薦赴聯合國任職
zh.dek: 第三批人員來自12個政府部門及政策局，本月起陸續啓程，於聯合國總部及日內瓦、維也納、內羅畢辦事處擔任兩年職位。
body: 16名香港特別行政區青年公務人員獲外交部推薦參與聯合國初級專業人員方案，人數為香港參與計劃以來最多。
發佈儀式今日在外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署舉行。人員分別來自財經事務及庫務局、漁農自然護理署、政府統計處、土木工程拓展署、香港海關、律政司、機電工程署、香港天文台、香港警務處、知識產權署、地政總署及廉政公署。
他們將以中國人員身分到聯合國總部以及瑞士日內瓦、奧地利維也納和肯亞內羅畢的辦事處工作，為期兩年，本月起陸續啓程。行政長官李家超表示，過往兩批人員表現出色，獲得聯合國高度評價，部分更獲延長任期。他寄語新一批人員心繫國家、香港及世界，當好超級聯繫人及超級增值人。
香港特區先後於2019年及2023年派出5名及12名人員參與同一計劃。
